interpretation.title: CRM Cloud Migration Plan
interpretation.audience: Chief Technology Officer and executive leadership
interpretation.objective: Provide a concise, decision‑ready plan to migrate the company’s CRM to the cloud within 6 weeks, staying within a tight budget while ensuring zero downtime
key_facts: Leadership wants migration completed in 6 weeks
missing_info: Target cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.)
Size of CRM data and databases
Compliance or regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA)
Available internal resources and skill sets
conflicts: Tight budget may limit ability to purchase premium migration tools or extra staffing
Zero‑downtime requirement adds complexity and may increase effort within the 6‑week timeline
assumptions: Number of CRM users is moderate (approximately 150‑250) and will be confirmed later
Current CRM runs on an on‑premise SQL‑based system (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics or similar)
Target cloud provider will be AWS, but the plan remains provider‑agnostic where possible
Allocated budget is roughly $50,000, reflecting a “tight” constraint
CRM data volume is about 200 GB, encompassing databases and attachments
Existing infrastructure includes standard on‑premise servers and network connectivity sufficient for migration
Compliance requirements are limited to GDPR‑style data protection, no industry‑specific mandates
Internal team consists of three senior engineers plus a part‑time project manager, with additional external support to be sourced if needed

plan.description: Write an executive summary that captures the migration goal, timeline, budget, zero‑downtime approach, and key decisions.
plan.instructions: Summarize objective, 6‑week schedule, $50k budget, blue‑green zero‑downtime strategy, and stakeholder responsibilities.

plan.description: Define project scope, objectives, and out‑of‑scope items.
plan.instructions: List what will be migrated (CRM application, database, attachments), target cloud (AWS, provider‑agnostic), and exclusions (legacy reporting tools, non‑CRM systems).

plan.description: Describe the migration approach and methodology.
plan.instructions: Detail the blue‑green migration pattern, data replication method, testing strategy, and cutover steps; reference key decisions for phases and owners.

plan.description: Create a detailed 6‑week timeline with phases and major milestones.
plan.instructions: Table columns: Week, Phase, Activities, Owner. Populate according to key decisions (Discovery, Build/Test, Cutover/Hypercare). Label as an estimate.

plan.description: Estimate effort per role and calculate total cost within the $50k budget.
plan.instructions: Use internal rates: Project Manager $120/hr, Solution Architect $150/hr, Cloud Engineer $130/hr, Data Engineer $125/hr, QA Engineer $110/hr, DevOps Engineer $130/hr, Support Engineer $100/hr. Include $10k contingency for external tools/vendor support. Ensure total ≤ $50,000.

plan.description: Identify major risks, mitigation actions, and impact on timeline/budget.
plan.instructions: Cover tight budget vs tool licensing, zero‑downtime complexity, data volume, and unknown user count. Align mitigations with phased approach.

plan.description: Document assumptions, open questions, and any conflicts to be resolved.
plan.instructions: List all assumptions from analysis, missing information (user count, exact CRM version, final budget approval), and note conflicts (budget vs zero‑downtime).

plan.description: Outline deliverables and acceptance criteria for the migration.
plan.instructions: Specify artifacts (architecture diagram, migration scripts, test results, cutover checklist) and criteria (no downtime > 5 min, data integrity verified, performance baseline met).

issues_found.problem: The cost estimate totals only $3,306, which contradicts the key decision that the budget cap is $50,000 total (including external vendor support, tools, and contingency). This also ignores the need for external migration tool licensing and a realistic effort allocation for the six‑week project.
issues_found.fix_instruction: Revise the Cost Estimate section to reflect the $50,000 budget cap. Include realistic effort (e.g., 2‑3 weeks of each engineer, 1 week of external vendor support, licensing fees for migration tools, AWS service costs, and a 10‑15% contingency). Show a breakdown that sums to approximately $50,000 and note any remaining contingency.
